authority: original inventory FastqUtils; no scope or annotation-credit changes

2.2.3.format: literal Plotly object/array payload in HTML

full_native_retention: Content-bound original bytes remain authoritative; field locators address bytes. Parser does not fetch scripts, execute HTML/JS, reacquire input, run a tool, or substitute filtered BAM.

shared_mapq_bins.qualification: 255 denotes unavailable mapping quality in SAM semantics, but native producer groups it here.

shared_mapq_bins.predicate: FLAG 0x4 overrides MAPQ; FASTX Unmapped is not an alignment outcome

fields.precision: exact integer token
fields.population: SAM/BAM records retained by producer: secondary FLAG 0x100 excluded, supplementary FLAG 0x800 included; R1 includes unpaired/non-R2 records. Each table column has its own population.
fields.denominator: None for count. Native total for each mate column is sum of four mutually exclusive bins.
fields.coordinates: Bin order ge30,10_29,0_9,unmapped,Total. ge30 includes MAPQ 255. MAPQ is not reference coordinate.
fields.missing_input_behavior: Missing column is absent, not a zero-filled mate. Independent complete columns survive truncated HTML.
qualifications: Native labels MAPQ gt 30 and MAPQ lt 30 are misleading: exact integer boundaries come from pinned get_mapqual_bins.
The report has no query-name identity or reference dictionary; counts are not deduplicated reads or pairs.

fields.precision: native_rounded: %.5f
fields.population: Same individual mate column as legacy_mapping_counts
fields.denominator: Each native mate-column Total
fields.coordinates: Same bin order; Total fraction is also retained
fields.missing_input_behavior: Literal -nan becomes state undefined, value null, original token retained; zero count cells remain available.

fields.precision: exact integer token
fields.population: FASTA/FASTQ sequences processed by native reader; no alignment attempt established
fields.denominator: None
fields.coordinates: none
fields.missing_input_behavior: No sentence/section: not_measured or malformed according to retained structural evidence, never inferred from density area.
qualifications: Unmapped plot names in FASTX mode mean the reader did not assign alignments; not evidence of failed alignment.

native_fields: Paired-end reads sentence count and percent
Properly paired reads sentence count and percent
fields.precision: integers exact; percentages native rounded to one decimal
fields.population: Records with FLAG paired / proper-pair in producer-retained record set
fields.denominator: Paired percentage: all retained records. Proper percentage: paired-flag record count. Never number of pairs.
fields.coordinates: none
fields.missing_input_behavior: Sentence absent does not establish an observed zero; retain absence.

fields.precision: native_estimator; x and y formatted %.6f
fields.population: Read-length observations for the named mate/MAPQ record stratum; missing sequence has no ordinary positive length observation
fields.denominator: Weighted normal KDE divided by total weighted observations, not native read counts; bandwidth population SD*(3N/4)^(-1/5)
fields.coordinates: x is an observed length in bp; points are not exhaustive integer histogram bins
fields.uncertainty: No interval or estimator variance emitted
fields.missing_input_behavior: Missing series stays absent. Single unique length is native fallback y=1.000000, diagnosed native_fallback_value. Do not invert density into counts.
qualifications: The native y-axis label Counts does not change its density meaning.

fields.precision: exact integer tokens only for unclustered axes
fields.population: Bases contributed by the named record stratum at the named coordinate, in sequenced orientation; variable coverage and missing sequences retained
fields.denominator: No numeric denominator emitted per base; sum of emitted symbol counts only if all symbol series for that cell are demonstrably represented
fields.coordinates: Default unclustered x labels 1..length. SAM/BAM default excludes soft clips then positions in trimmed sequence; reverse records are reoriented. End plots use full sequence from its end despite caption. Norm assigns floor(100*p/trimmed_length), displayed index+1. Native label retained.
fields.missing_input_behavior: Omitted all-zero groups/series and malformed arrays remain explicit absence; parser must not fabricate omitted zeros.

native_fields: bc_R*_*.y with clustered .x labels, including >250-bp examples
fields.precision: native_rounded: integer round(sum(position counts)/number positions assigned to cluster)
fields.population: Same stratum as legacy_base_position_counts, but several positions summarized
fields.denominator: Number of positions assigned to native cluster, not number of reads or bases
fields.coordinates: For 300-bp example x singleton labels start 0, then 250-255 etc. Textual cluster labels are not reliable closed interval endpoints. Use native_label axis with bounds null, preserve exact label.
fields.uncertainty: No variance or rounding interval emitted
fields.missing_input_behavior: Do not recover total bases by multiplying the displayed value by a guessed width.
qualifications: Source clustering can include an allocated terminal empty position. Even integer-looking values may be rounded averages.

fields.precision: native_rounded: %.6f; score indices capped at 41 before summary
fields.population: SAM/BAM quality-bearing bases of the named stratum/position; missing qualities omitted; for clustered axes statistics use rounded cluster histograms
fields.denominator: n quality-bearing bases at that position is not emitted; mean=sum(cq*q)/n; SEM=sqrt(sum(cq*(q-mean)^2)/n)/sqrt(n)
fields.coordinates: Same position conventions as corresponding base plot; native series number is a group offset, not a quality score
fields.uncertainty: error_y.array is native SEM under population-variance formula, not SD, confidence, or posterior probability
fields.missing_input_behavior: If all qualities missing, no series. Empty positions can have native zero placeholder: retain with native_fallback_value, no unsupported assertion of observed Q0.
qualifications: Do not send these means to quality_phred_v1, which requires a histogram and actual quality population.
Do not combine position SEMs into a whole-file uncertainty without covariance/sample sizes.

native_fields: bq_R*_*.y/.error_y.array under File statistics FASTX mode
fields.precision: native_rounded %.6f with known producer limitation
fields.population: FASTX character indices left at offset 0 in pinned 2.2.3 build, capped at 41; these are not decoded biological Phred values
fields.denominator: Native arithmetic summary as above, but over incorrectly decoded/capped indices
fields.coordinates: same as legacy quality axes
fields.uncertainty: Native SEM of native indices only; not valid Phred SEM
fields.missing_input_behavior: Keep actual numbers and samstat_fastx_quality_offset_defect diagnostic; do not repair with an assumed offset or recompute from unretained input.
qualifications: Observed on this pinned source execution. Does not establish a defect in an unknown BV-BRC deployed executable.

fields.precision: exact unclustered integer token; clustered variants must use native_normalized/native_rounded metric suffix _rounded_bin_mean
fields.population: Error events reconstructed by native CIGAR/MD processing for named mate/MAPQ stratum; mismatch base labels describe read bases
fields.denominator: No coverage denominator or native error rate emitted; indel values count gap openings, not bases in gaps
fields.coordinates: Native read position after native orientation/soft-clip handling, not genomic coordinate. Preserve x unchanged and the soft-clip defect qualification.
fields.missing_input_behavior: Absent MD yields no known mismatch information; zero displayed mismatch is not proof of error-free alignment.
qualifications: Pinned parse_alignment advances sequence cursor by one for any S operation, not its length; native reconstructed mismatch assignment after multi-base soft clipping can be wrong. Preserve native output; no silent correction.

native_fields: dl.strip dt Reads or Reads (R1+R2), dd main and exact span.sub
dl.strip dt Bases, dd main and exact span.sub
fields.precision: Exact integer when unscaled main token or exact comma-separated span.sub; preserve separate SI display with native_rounded
fields.population: Only primary alignment records: both secondary and supplementary excluded. FASTA/FASTQ counts are sequences. Bases are full sequence bases including soft clips, excluding absent SEQ. R1+R2 does not mean pair count.
fields.denominator: None
fields.coordinates: none
fields.missing_input_behavior: Bases n/a with absent sequence is not zero observed bases. Empty file native banner establishes 0 contributing records but no ordinary sequence/quality summaries.
qualifications: Use exact sublabel for arithmetic; do not reconstruct exact count from SI main display alone.

native_fields: Read 1 and Read 2 subcolumns when present
fields.precision: exact comma-separated integer tokens
fields.population: Primary alignment records, all/R1-or-unpaired/R2 table populations kept separate
fields.denominator: None; four disjoint bins exhaust each represented mate selection
fields.coordinates: [30,255],[10,29],[0,9],unmapped flag override. MAPQ255 included in first bin, not known-confidence evidence.
fields.missing_input_behavior: Table absent for FASTX or no-read report; do not infer alignment outcomes from sequence-mode plot names.

fields.precision: native_rounded: one decimal
fields.population: All primary alignment records included by report
fields.denominator: All primary report records, including unmapped. ge30 is first bin / total, not divided only by mapped.
fields.coordinates: MAPQ table axes as above; cards axis none
fields.missing_input_behavior: n/a -> not_measured/undefined according to zero denominator source meaning; native empty-file banner has no table.

native_fields: plot-1 SVG desc Read lengths range from ... to ...
plot-1 note All N reads are ... long / The read is ... long
fields.precision: Native integer bp below display cutoff; large values rounded to one decimal kb/Mb. Tilde marks lower-edge storage-bin estimate, keep native_estimator and original token. Never claim exact bp from rounded unit display.
fields.population: Full sequence lengths of primary records/FASTX sequences; absent SEQ contributes no positive length
fields.denominator: Median lower quantile of length counts; N50 length threshold for half of total bases, native length-bin representation
fields.coordinates: Length units, not reference coordinates; min/max descriptions repeat global extrema in each mate figure
fields.uncertainty: No uncertainty interval; binning/format precision only
fields.missing_input_behavior: No sequence -> n/a; no histogram distribution recoverable from SVG paths.
qualifications: Native storage bins are exact below 1000 and approximately 1% logarithmic above; display units create additional rounding. Uniform-length reports can refine native median/N50.

fields.precision: native_rounded to one decimal; native fixed-point error table adds finite numerical approximation
fields.population: All bases with usable qualities in all included primary/FASTX records, including soft clips; missing QUAL bases excluded
fields.denominator: -10*log10(sum(round(2^30*10^(-min(Q,93)/10)))/(n*2^30)), with native zero-error saturation at Q93
fields.coordinates: none
fields.uncertainty: No variance, SEM, confidence interval or quality-base count emitted in HTML
fields.missing_input_behavior: No quality-bearing bases -> card omitted, not_measured, not zero.
qualifications: Different statistic from arithmetic mean Phred; two Q0/Q40 bases give 3.0 here versus legacy mean 20.000000.

native_fields: plot-2 SVG desc from Q{min_bin} to Q{max_bin}
fields.precision: integer bin indices, not exact unbinned quality extrema
fields.population: Across all mates and mapping strata with quality-bearing reads; the same global extrema repeat in both mate figures
fields.denominator: Per-read error-probability mean assigned to native integer quality bin
fields.coordinates: Quality-bin index, axis quality_score
fields.missing_input_behavior: No quality -> no range. SVG x ticks are plotting configuration and must not be promoted to data.

fields.precision: native_rounded to one decimal
fields.population: Mapped primary records with sequence; terminal soft clips counted in sequenced bases
fields.denominator: 100*soft_clipped_bases / total full-sequence bases of mapped records; not denominator of all bases if unmapped present
fields.coordinates: CIGAR terminal soft clips, not hard clips; no retained per-base clipping map
fields.missing_input_behavior: No mapped sequence bases -> n/a.

fields.precision: native_estimator: lower median of 0.1 percentage-point bins; shown one decimal
fields.population: Mapped primary records where native identity is computable from NM plus CIGAR or explicit X operations; MD alone does not establish identity
fields.denominator: Per record (aligned M/X/= bases - mismatches)/(aligned M/X/= bases + insertion-open events + deletion-open events), then native median; not global matching bases / all alignment columns
fields.coordinates: No residue/reference correspondence retained; gap openings differ from gap lengths
fields.uncertainty: No interval; empirical binned median only
fields.missing_input_behavior: n/a if no calculable identities; incompatible NM/CIGAR treated unavailable by producer.

native_fields: notes mismatches: X of Y mapped reads lack MD/X
notes identity unavailable: X of Y mapped reads
notes fewer than N reads / hidden plots
fields.precision: exact comma-separated integer tokens
fields.population: Numerator is the named unavailable/excluded population. Note denominator is mapped primary report records. Display threshold 50 is producer configuration, not a measurement. Excluded secondary/supplementary records are not contributors.
fields.denominator: Named note denominator only, not all primary records for missing-data fractions
fields.coordinates: none
fields.missing_input_behavior: Conditional note absence is not parsed as observed zero; preserve unsupported/absent section if not recognizable.

native_fields: notes percentage of bases beyond position axis
fields.precision: one decimal rounded value or explicit strict upper bound <0.1; bound metric records 0.1 with native token and strictness fixed by metric definition
fields.population: Bases used in positional plots; clipped/axis conventions follow native plot collection
fields.denominator: beyond/(beyond+in_axis)*100, counts not persisted in HTML
fields.coordinates: Beyond short-layout position axis, not genome coordinates
fields.uncertainty: No statistical uncertainty; display censoring only
fields.missing_input_behavior: Absent note gives no observed count or fraction; do not assume zero.
qualifications: Source established; no positive beyond-axis native example was run in this workload.

fields.precision: Not recoverable from rounded geometry
fields.population: Native plot descriptions describe populations; paths do not provide original numerical arrays
fields.denominator: Unavailable from HTML; optional --json arrays are a separate artifact not requested by actual caller
fields.coordinates: Do not reverse engineer path coordinates into native observations. Axis ticks and rendering sizes are not scientific measurements.
fields.missing_input_behavior: Retain full raw SVG and label text. Requested exact histograms/position measurements return not_measured + requested_measurement requirement.

native_examples.role: comparison only, not actual caller output

native_fields: Complete-looking report after legacy read error
fields.meaning: observed_count / no measurement for caller failure
fields.precision: Retain whatever complete numeric tokens exist; no recovery from nonexistent or truncated fields
fields.population: Native prefix population if declared; otherwise original input consumption remains unknown without run/input evidence
fields.denominator: Only complete native table counts may form a prefix-specific denominator
fields.coordinates: none
fields.uncertainty: Original-input completeness is unknown independently of HTML transfer completeness
fields.missing_input_behavior: Caller stub: failed measurement null; supported HTML with truncated structural section: preserve independent cells and typed partial. Exit 0 alone does not prove full consumption.
qualifications: Legacy peeking operates after whole default 10000-record chunks. Modern peeking enforces exact record limit. Neither prefix is a random sample.
Caller labels every CalledProcessError a segfault; retained code 1 must not be rewritten as SIGSEGV.

not_retained: read names and unique molecule identities
reference sequence dictionary and genomic coordinate maps
full-input denominator beyond reported contributing records
exact modern position/length/quality/error/identity arrays from HTML
legacy original unclustered histograms behind clustered averages and KDE
